mechanism: Both drugs increase gastrointestinal ulceration and bleeding risk; betamethasone impairs mucosal healing and ibuprofen inhibits protective prostaglandins, with additive NSAID and corticosteroid immunosuppression.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with gastroprotection (proton pump inhibitor or H2-receptor antagonist) and monitor for GI bleeding, infection, and fluid retention.
